dossier.title: Sprint 42 summary: Oct 1-15
dossier.subtitle: Built text search and saved filters. Resolved five tech debt items. Dropped streaming due to missing spec.

blocks.text: The sprint completed 8 of 9 planned features. We closed 45 issues and shipped v2.3.0 to production.

pages.title: Dropped work
pages.summary: What we said no to and why.

blocks.text: We dropped the streaming API feature (planned as a low-priority nice-to-have). The spec was incomplete when the sprint started, and tech debt cleanup took longer than estimated. We will revisit this in Sprint 44.
Dropping one thing meant we had time to fix the database connection pooling issue that was on the backlog. That fix has higher ROI.

items.text: Search performance exceeded targets (140ms instead of 250ms)
A/B test showed 15% increase in feature usage after rollout
Zero incidents during release. Rollback was not needed.
Pair programming on indexer improved code quality

blocks.text: Two things slowed us down. First, we underestimated database migration complexity (added 3 days). Second, design review cycles were slower than planned (one design was reworked twice before dev started).

items.text: For next sprint: schedule design reviews earlier and aim for one round of feedback
For database work: reserve 25% buffer on estimates instead of 10%
